notes.title: Hive Mind VS Mode!
notes.content:
Working together is great, but proving you're the best bee is greater! 

Hive Mind VS Mode is here, with 1v1 and 2v2 action, race to fill up to 7 cells per team using any means necessary! 
Stealing, blocking, purposely running out of containers while you have a lead... Anything goes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38759770/93c1cb26a95b2802bc1c08d0e4eff4c7f1f4da4b.png[/img]



*NEW*
- 1v1 and 2v2 VS Mode.
- "Attack" ability, be close to another bee and interact towards them to make them dizzy and drop what they are carrying (if there is space for it to be dropped).
- Dizzy particle effect.
- More localization for new text.

*BUGFIXES*
- Fixed clients not being able to fill cells with the last remaining container.
- Fixed colour issues with cells in the ice level.
- Fixed rotating platform from sometimes moving too fast/slow.
- Fixed container problem when removing container at the same time the bread maker bee starts working.

notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.content:
2 new maps to play over the festive period!
An alternate universe hive where you must fill the cells before winter ends and a hive with a built in maze to get lost in!
